summary: Alternus Clean Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 1, 2026, reporting a corporate name change to Aedis Energy Inc., effective August 31, 2026. The change was approved by the board on June 16, 2026, and by majority written consent of stockholders, with a Certificate of Amendment filed in Delaware. No financial terms, shares, or premiums were involved. Shares trade under temporary symbol ALCED, soon changing to ADIS. This is a routine name-change event, not a special situation.
